documented_semantics: disrupted_sympathy_retention is documented as the fraction of disrupted membership retained as latent sympathy rather than erased from the social state.
observed_implementation: Membership assignment writes rebel_sympathy equal to the armed membership fraction and insurgent_affinity equal to that fraction.
Underground disruption computes retained_sympathy = prior_armed_fraction * disrupted_sympathy_retention.
It then writes rebel_sympathy = max(existing_rebel_sympathy, retained_sympathy) and likewise maxes insurgent_affinity.
For a member whose existing sympathy/affinity already equals the prior armed fraction, any retention value <= 1 therefore cannot lower those continuous fields.
A fully disrupted armed participant is changed to the discrete insurgent-sympathy public behavior, whose social signal is 0.7 independent of disrupted_sympathy_retention.
implication: The retention parameter appears to act as a floor rather than a retained fraction in the common one-insurgent membership path, and may be largely ineffective at controlling the magnitude of post-disruption social support.
decision: Do not alter the mechanism from this source audit alone. Add a focused unit/assay test before any correction, and treat existing rebound findings as properties of the currently implemented model.
